remarks: Fabulous Townhouse across from the Golf Course. Picture living in this spacious coveted corner unit of Mill Bridge in central Stamford. There is a wood burning fireplace in the living room with slider to the balcony and views to the brook below. It's rare to have 2 carport spaces attached to the unit and a full-sized laundry in unit just off the master suite. Great kitchen with brand new stainless appliances, new sink faucet and granite counter tops with a tile floor leading to a sunny dining room with a bay window. Freshly painted, 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths end unit w/ private entrance featuring a brick walkway and gardens. Walking distance to Scalzi Park, just a few blocks to shopping, restaurants and just minutes to the RR station and downtown. Don't miss this opportunity to own this sought-after mid-city gem.
